overview: Sever Force is a master-level light side technique classified under Purification. Cuts a Force-sensitive individual off from the Force entirely, leaving them unable to sense or wield its power—a punishment reserved for the gravest betrayals. The Jedi Council considered severing as an alternative to execution for fallen members who could not be redeemed.
history:
Force scholars trace Sever Force across eras recorded in holocrons, Jedi Archives data-tapes, and Sith tombs on Korriban and Dromund Kaas. Practitioners documented in KOTOR II · The Old Republic · Clone Wars · High Republic established the modern understanding of how this ability manifests in combat, meditation, and ritual.

During the Old Republic and Sith Empire conflicts, masters drilled Sever Force into initiates as part of the standard curriculum for purification specialisation. Surviving battle logs from the Clone Wars and Galactic Civil War show the technique adapted to blaster-era warfare, starfighter engagements, and close-quarters lightsaber duels.

In the sequel era, surviving texts and oral traditions kept knowledge of Sever Force alive even as the Jedi Temple fell and the Sith assumed new forms. Each generation reinterpreted the power through its own doctrine while the underlying Force mechanism — channelled midi-chlorian symbiosis and focused will — remained constant.

The Jedi teach that this ability must serve life, consent, and the greater good — never domination or fear.
significance:
Sever Force exemplifies how purification abilities shape Force doctrine on the light side. At master mastery, users balance raw potential against discipline, emotional control, and the moral weight of their choices.

Historians note that armies and orders rose or fell partly on how widely and wisely this technique was taught. A single master of Sever Force could turn a skirmish, break a siege, or unravel an enemy's will before blades crossed.

For students today — in academies, hidden enclaves, or alone with ancient texts — Sever Force remains a benchmark of purification proficiency across the Star Wars saga.
